sections.title: Shipping line catalog
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Master data > Shipping line catalog

**Access rights:** Users with Master Data management rights

Use the path above to open the screen where you create a new shipping line.

![](/uploads/b09720e2d87bac363de4ea5c.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new shipping line.

![](/uploads/813a873217d58b0ef8720dae.png)

### Step 2

After you click **NEW**, the system adds a new data row on the list view.

![](/uploads/3ccfdcfa9daddb6d18dc8d2b.png)

**Fields to pay attention to:**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Name | Enter the name of the shipping line. |
| 2 | Shipping line code | Enter the shipping line code. The system does not allow duplicate codes. |
| 3 | Company | The system fills in the creator's company. If there are several companies (for example branches of a group), select the right one. |

### Step 3

Once you have entered the information, click **SAVE** to save it.

![](/uploads/927c2fa459e5240da83c5dd2.png)

The record has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/c20f9acdb5f8faea9d39f73e.png)

sections.title: Container transfer plans
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Master data > Container transfer plans

**Access rights:** Users with Master Data management rights

Use the path above to open the screen where you create container transfer plans at the port.

![](/uploads/bb60074701c1a0f4da1cff81.png)



## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new container transfer plan.

![](/uploads/aa47758f7a463ada55a79273.png)

### Step 2

Enter the transfer options.

![](/uploads/9826334c535eb103b0bcaf1c.png)

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Container transfer option | Enter the name of the option. |
| 2 | Company | Select the company the option belongs to. |

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** and the system creates the new record.

![](/uploads/938e314407623fb51eb492e1.png)
